hooks.command: if [ "${OPENCLINXR_WORKER:-0}" = "1" ] || [ "${OPENCLINXR_WORKER:-}" = "true" ] || [ -n "${GROK_SUBAGENT:-}" ] || { git_top="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" && case "$git_top" in *".grok/worktrees"*) true ;; *) false ;; esac; }; then echo 'DOC HYGIENE: skipped (worker/subagent session or managed worktree; OPENCLINXR_WORKER, GROK_SUBAGENT, or .grok/worktrees toplevel)'; exit 0; fi; pnpm docs:hygiene:session-start -- --auto-run 2>/dev/null || echo 'DOC HYGIENE: run pnpm docs:hygiene:session-start -- --auto-run (install/tsx if needed)'
